declarations.text: I, Rajan Rao, hereby declare my concern or interest in the following: I am a director and shareholder of Rao Family Holdings Private Limited. My wife Meera Rao is a director of the Company. My brother Vikram Rao is a director of Rao Warehousing Private Limited. My daughter Kavya Rao is a partner in the firm Kavya Traders.
I, Meera Rao, hereby declare that I am a shareholder of Rao Family Holdings Private Limited and hold no other directorships or partnerships.
I, Arvind Shah, declare that I hold directorships in the following bodies corporate: Shah Advisory Services LLP.
I, Suresh Iyer, declare that I am a director of Iyer Infra Private Limited and hold 60 per cent of its shares.
I, Anil Desai, declare that I have no concern or interest in any body corporate or firm other than the Company.
